title: Sea Foam Green Shower Basket, 18.75-Inch Wall Mount Solid Brass Oval Combination Caddy, Allied Brass
description: Shower basket with 18 in Sea Foam Green, which captures the tranquil essence of ocean-inspired design, bringing soft, natural color to coastal and contemporary spaces. 75 in length for bathroom shower storage; wall mount solid brass construction with rust-proof solid brass wires and concealed screw mounting for a clean installation. Oval combination shower basket design helps organize soap, shampoo, and bath items while ventilated heavy-gauge wire promotes drainage. Traditional style accessory for classic bath accessories and heritage bathroom fixtures; designer finish is made for corrosion-free and rust-free performance. Includes basket and all installation hardware; no assembly required. Limited lifetime warranty. Product dimensions: 18.75 L x 2.25 H x 4.13 W in (4.13 in projection). Allied Brass.
